dispositions.finding: UTF-8 conversion while scanning schema column names

Verified against rusqlite 0.40.2. Review incorrectly described the guard as OR; actual guard is column_count > 0 AND readonly, so BEGIN was not broken. The SELECT precheck can still change the error path. Bound execution now performs one raw_query step and is tested both with and without extra_check on both Rust versions.

dispositions.action: Already strengthened to write successfully after reopening, proving the old writer lock was released.

dispositions.finding: Special-filename documentation could imply URI mode
dispositions.action: Named :memory: and the empty filename explicitly; no URI flag is enabled.
Confirmed fixture uses default DELETE journal mode and warms all three queries before taking the exclusive lock.
